archetype: ARCHETYPE 5: LUXURY & HIGH-TECH (Midnight Blue & Electric Glow)
summary: Commercial multi-user SaaS for generating printable 10x10cm NFC plaques with unique permanent editable dynamic QR codes. Features auth-only entrance with elevated 3D glass card, approval gate, multi-template batch generator (10/30/50/100), interactive calibration canvas for admins, batch detail with PDF A4 & ZIP exports, QR code redirect manager, and customer/admin dashboards.

rules.labels_overline: font-sans uppercase text-[11px] font-bold tracking-[0.2em] text-blue-400

entry_surfaces./: centered elevated 3D glass card auth screen with electric blue lighting bloom, DINÂMICO PRO 3D metallic logo, switchable tabs for login and registration
entry_surfaces./login: centered elevated 3D glass card auth screen with electric blue lighting bloom, DINÂMICO PRO 3D metallic logo, fields E-mail / Senha, primary ENTRAR, secondary CRIAR CONTA / ESQUECI SENHA
entry_surfaces./register: centered elevated 3D glass card auth screen with fields Nome completo, E-mail, Senha, Confirmar senha, CADASTRAR, VOLTAR AO LOGIN
entry_surfaces./pending: centered elevated 3D glass card with animated status badge, explanation of admin approval pending, and status refresh / logout actions
entry_surfaces./app: dark command center layout with midnight blue sidebar, metrics bar, tab navigation for Gerar Lote, Meus Lotes, Meus QR Codes, Exportações and Configurações
entry_surfaces./admin: high-contrast admin control panel with key SaaS statistics, approval queue table with instant status toggles, and live 10x10cm plaque calibration canvas

visual_enhancers.plaque_card_art: rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-blue-500/20 bg-gradient-to-b from-[#111C35] to-[#0A1224] transition-all hover:scale-[1.02] hover:border-cyan-400/50 hover:shadow-[0_10px_30px_rgba(0,229,255,0.2)]
visual_enhancers.metallic_badge: bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-900/60 via-slate-800/80 to-blue-900/60 border border-blue-400/30 text-blue-200

accessibility.contrast_target: WCAG AA (minimum 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for bold/display)
accessibility.keyboard_navigation: All modal dialogs, plaque selectors, batch quantities, and calibration sliders are keyboard controllable
accessibility.test_attributes: All inputs, buttons, plaque templates, status badges, calibration controls, and exports MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

key_features_and_rules.plaque_dimensions: 10x10 cm square format, 300 DPI print ready calculation
key_features_and_rules.admin_calibration_tool: Allows interactive drag & numeric precision inputs for QR code (X, Y, size, padding) and Serial number (X, Y, font-size, color, alignment) over 10x10cm plaque canvas with live zoom and real preview

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Verbatim Visual Identity: Deep midnight-blue (#030712 / #050C1A / #0A1224), electric cyan/blue highlights (#00E5FF / #38BDF8 / #2563EB), clean white typography (#F8FAFC), glassmorphism with delicate 1px border overlays, and 3D lighting depth.
Do NOT use red as the primary interface color (only for destructive actions like delete/block).

Portuguese text everywhere: 'DINÂMICO PRO', 'ENTRAR', 'CADASTRAR', 'ESQUECI MINHA SENHA', 'Aguardando aprovação', 'Gerar lote', 'Meus lotes', 'Meus QR Codes', 'Exportações', 'Configurações', 'Compradores', 'BAIXAR PDF A4', etc.
Make the authentication screen the root view for unauthenticated visitors (NO generic marketing landing page).

Provide a simulated multi-role switch or easy demo login buttons (e.g. Admin: admin@dinamicopro.com.br, Cliente Aprovado: cliente@empresa.com.br, Cliente Pendente: novo@empresa.com.br) so testers and judges can immediately test all 3 states.

Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='login-email-input', data-testid='batch-generate-btn', data-testid='download-pdf-a4-btn', data-testid='template-calibration-save').

Implement real client-side PDF A4 generation for batches (e.g. using jsPDF or html2canvas/canvas rendering with 4 plaques per A4 sheet with cut marks) so the 'BAIXAR PDF A4' button delivers real printable files.
